picks.name: caliper
picks.description: Run your real agent with and without your skills, MCPs, and rules. See which ones actually help, and what they cost in tokens. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Hermes.
picks.reason: 不是再刷一遍 pass@k：`--ablate` 把「去掉技能」存成一份普通 run，`diff_runs` 才是 compare 的全部逻辑。autorater 两种模式——直接 verdict，或写 `assert` 脚本；脚本超时返回 `None`，不当失败。`classify` 只读 CLI 自己写的字（agent 答「rate limit」不算），这周把 judge 的拒绝按同一套读——quota 中止整场，throttle 才重试。适合看「技能有没有赚回它占的上下文」。

picks.name: shrt
picks.description: A contract-driven gRPC regression harness for AI coding agents, with human-approved baselines. Snapshot the valid call chains of an API so an agent can look one up instead of tracing for it. gRPC today, OpenAPI next
picks.reason: 不是再录一遍 HTTP：合同写 `effects`，`plan` 组链，`confirm` 才钉绿。`Without` 抽掉一步会连带抽掉只读它的步。`suspectWrite` 读步坏了先找碰过同一实体的写；写自己的答案变了就还是它自己的嫌疑，除非更早的写够到那个字段。这周 lean-trace 把不清楚的摘要组一次说完，流式步的 verdict 从自己的 messages 读。适合看「编码 agent 改 API 时怎么把红归因到某次写」。

picks.name: fauxnix
picks.description: Run Linux-style commands on Windows via deterministic bash→PowerShell translation. No VM, no WSL. MCP server + CLI built for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode...). GNU-style output, bash-style errors, UTF-8/GBK handled.
picks.reason: 不是再套一层 WSL：自己 tokenize/parse bash，`translateCommandList` 确定性编成 PowerShell，运行时零 LLM。`pure` 模式连 `sed -f` 都拒读磁盘。这周 facade 冒充 `bash.exe`：剥掉 Claude Code 的 `export && shopt && eval PAYLOAD && pwd -P` 脚手架，只跑 payload，失败不写 cwd marker（对齐 bash 的 `&&`）。适合对照 Windows-MCP 看「UIA 握鼠标」和「内置 Bash 工具改走本地翻译层」差在哪。

picks.name: aoci-code
picks.description: A persistent, Git-versioned map of your whole codebase and database schema that coding agents read before they touch anything. Local-first MCP server + CLI in Go: a governed repository index of code knowledge that gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and opencode long-term context, memory, and code intelligence.
picks.reason: 不是 AST 图谱：模型写一行 FRAS（职责 / 必读 / 接口 / 不能错的），索引进 Git。`#FRAS-v2-Limits-Authority: machine-contract` 字段上限在二进制里，项目改 Meta 加不宽。`validateVolumeAuthoringDelta` 旧的带点 tag 仍能加载，新写必须 compact ABCDE。这周 `fillTargetEScale` 无阈值表不猜档，200 行边界稳定给出 M/S 双档，文件不在盘就留空。适合对照 graphify 看「解析出来的图」和「模型写的、机器守预算的索引」差在哪。
